utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Seal Beach' by name among the cities in its service area.

generation_supplier.notes: Orange County Power Authority (OCPA), the CCA operating in Orange County, currently names Buena Park, Fullerton, Irvine, and Fountain Valley as members — Seal Beach was not named among current members this session. Left null rather than asserted either way.

county.notes: Seal Beach is a well-documented Orange County city; also listed under Orange County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of Seal Beach Community Development Department, Building & Safety Division

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Seal Beach/Orange County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: Electrical Plan prepared by an electrical contractor or electrical engineer (main service/disconnect locations, module/string counts, inverter make/model, one-line diagram, grounding/bonding, conductor sizing, battery locations if applicable, equipment cut sheets, CEC 690/705 labeling, site diagram with shading elements)
Three complete sets of plans for permit review and approval
Structural support information for roof-mounted systems (roof covering/framing, panel weight/attachment, framing plan, calculations, racking system documentation)
Production analysis (if panels are visible from public view and relocating would cause a 10%+ efficiency loss, per SBMC 11.4.10.045 and California Civil Code Section 714)

value: Schedule on-site inspection by calling the Building Division at 562-431-2527 ext. 1519

Common inspection points: PV module count/model matches plans, workmanlike array conductor installation, proper array grounding, accessible electrical boxes, proper fastening/sealing, conductor ratings matching plans, required signage (PV power source at DC disconnect, AC point of connection, alternative power system switch), and equipment ratings consistent with installed signage

value.program_or_pathway: Standard plan-check submittal for systems under 10kW
other_conditions: Planning review is required for all solar PV installations (not waived at this size, unlike most other cities' expedited pathways)
Fire Department approval is not required for solar PV installations of this size in residential areas

Solar collectors must be placed in the location least visible from public streets or screened from public view (SBMC 11.4.10.045), unless doing so causes a 10%+ efficiency loss per California Civil Code Section 714

value.name: Plan Check and Permit Fee (residential photovoltaic)
value.notes: The city's own guidelines state: 'No fee for residential photovoltaic installations.'

value.name: Inspection Fee
value.notes: Additional electrical permit fees may be required if a new electrical panel is installed.
